notes: 'so' is read as the closing member of the correlative pair the ASV writes for the comparative כְּ (rule 14) rather than as an added apodosis connective; the competing reading marks it added under rule 14's closing sentences.
The competing reading gives the written 'me' to the object suffix and marks the explicit אֲנִי unrepresented; the explicit pronoun standing beside גַּם was preferred.
